scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/publish.mjs --prepare && python3 scripts/package.py --source-root .build/plugins --index dist/index.json
scripts.package:example: npm run build && python3 scripts/package.py --plugin-dir .build/templates/typescript --output dist/typescript-example.nexlet
scripts.package:backend: npm run build && python3 scripts/package.py --plugin-dir .build/templates/backend --output dist/backend-example.nexlet
scripts.package:ctool: npm run build:ctool && python3 scripts/package.py --plugin-dir .build/plugins/ctool --output dist/ctool.nexlet
